target.description: Infer continuous, smoothed spike rates from spinal-cord calcium fluorescence against paired electrophysiology. Discrete-spike detection and in-vivo denoising are different endpoints.

dataset.description: CASCADE ground-truth datasets DS40 and DS41, as linked by the paper; exact archival bytes and paper code configuration remain to be bound.

cohort.description: Figure 4d–e specifies 21 glutamatergic and 23 GABAergic spinal neurons. Preserve both populations and each original condition; cortex is a separate comparator dataset.

split.description: Within-dataset retraining excludes the test neuron, including its recordings, for every evaluated neuron. Cross-dataset and cortical-default models remain distinct comparators.

inputs.description: Extracted calcium ΔF/F traces; paired electrical spikes provide targets, never candidate inputs.

preprocessing.description: Paper Figure 4d–f uses 30 Hz, standardized noise 7 and 50 ms Gaussian target smoothing; other conditions have different kernels. Recover exact resampling/noise realizations, edge handling and source-era dataset-wide delay correction. The current demo noise grid 2,4,6,8 is not this original grid.

metric.description: Pearson correlation of inferred and target spike-rate traces, higher is better. Error and signed bias must remain separate diagnostics rather than a new composite score.

aggregation.description: Original figure boxplots summarize per-neuron results separately by cell type and condition. The current demo additionally pools noise rows; that pooled summary is not the paper estimator.

full_panel.description: Reproduce and assess improvements in the paper's continuous spike-rate inference comparison on paired spinal calcium/electrophysiology recordings, preserving both spinal populations, the source-defined held-neuron exclusions, original sampling/noise/target-smoothing conditions, cortical/default and cross-dataset CASCADE, raw fluorescence and OASIS comparators, and source-grounded correlation, bias and error outcomes. Retain complete per-neuron and condition panels and necessary alignment and temporal-precision controls. Report reproduction and source-qualified improvement separately. Acquisition experiments and the downstream in-vivo application remain outside this bounded task. Mandatory outputs are the complete original five-method Figure 4 per-neuron main comparison with separate nominal 21 glutamatergic, 23 GABAergic and 80 cortex cohorts; original sampling/noise sweeps and matched temporal-precision controls; dataset-wide alignment and OASIS smoothing/delay controls; and source-grounded correlation, rate-error and signed-bias outputs with their original timescale/model/support definitions. The Figure 6a–c mapping remains unresolved. Error and bias remain separate outputs, not a composite score, and must not be replaced by the accepted single-pass diagnostics. The broader thirteen-group source census is not an enrolled primary. No acquisition, Figure 7 in-vivo, descriptive kernel/event/relative-segment or Figure 3d simulation result is added by this declaration. Complete numerical references, identities and comparison criteria remain unresolved.

permitted_observations.description: Inference candidates receive the source calcium ΔF/F observations under the original conditions. Electrical events are authorized supervised training targets within each source training fold and trusted operator evaluation targets for held-neuron inference; they are never held-neuron candidate-time inference inputs. Each test neuron and all its recordings are excluded from within-dataset training. Source cross-dataset controls, high-rate training exclusions, delay-selection observations and exact support/exposure manifests must be authenticated. Keep paper+data and paper+data+official-author-code paired observations, task, evaluator and budgets matched with only the pinned official-code addition differing; no complete paired protocol is declared.
